Errors.BAD_REQUEST: The request couldn't be read. Reload the page and try again.
Errors.CORS_PREFLIGHT_REJECTED: The portal isn't allowed to reach the API from this address. Contact support.
Errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
Errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do this. Ask an admin if you need it.
Errors.NOT_FOUND: This record no longer exists. It may have been deleted.
Errors.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: This action isn't available. Reload the page and try again.
Errors.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: This is too much to send at once. Shorten the text and try again.
Errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some fields need attention. Check the highlighted fields.
Errors.INVALID_CURSOR: This page of results has expired. Go back to the first page.
Errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED: The request was missing a safety key. Reload the page and try again.
Errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISMATCH: This action changed while it was being sent. Close the form and start again.
Errors.IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS: This action is still being processed. Wait a moment, then check the result.
Errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
Errors.STAFF_EMAIL_TAKEN: Someone on the staff list already uses this email.
Errors.AUTH_ACCOUNT_EXISTS: This email already has a sign-in account outside the staff list. Contact support.
Errors.LAST_ACTIVE_ADMIN: At least one active admin must remain. Make someone else an admin first.
Errors.AREA_NAME_TAKEN: An area with this name already exists.
Errors.AREA_IN_USE: This area is still used by a corridor, a route or an open route request.
Errors.CORRIDOR_EXISTS: A corridor between these two areas already exists.
Errors.COMPANY_NAME_TAKEN: A company with this name already exists.
Errors.ROUTE_CODE_TAKEN: Another route already uses this code.
Errors.SEATS_BELOW_TAKEN: Seats can't be fewer than the seats already taken on this route.
Errors.SEATS_BELOW_LAUNCH_MINIMUM: Seats can't be fewer than the route's launch minimum.
Errors.ROUTE_HAS_RIDERS: Riders are reserved or riding on this route, so this change isn't allowed.
Errors.CORRIDOR_IN_USE: A route uses this corridor, so it can't be changed or deleted.
Errors.COMPANY_IN_USE: This company has routes that block this change.
Errors.ROUTE_HAS_NO_PRICES: Company routes don't have prices: the rate is agreed with the company.
Errors.ROUTE_NOT_READY: This route isn't ready for this change yet. Reload it to see what it still needs.
Errors.NOT_ENOUGH_RIDERS: Not enough riders are reserved to launch on this date.
Errors.INVALID_STATUS_CHANGE: This status change isn't possible from the route's current status. Reload it to see what's allowed.
Errors.ROUTE_REQUEST_EXISTS: This person already has an open request for the same thing.
Errors.ROUTE_HAS_REQUESTS: Open route requests name this route, so this change isn't allowed.
Errors.ROUTE_HAS_PRICES: This route has prices, so its corridor and school can't change. Add a new route instead.
Errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Try again; if it keeps happening, contact support with the reference.
Errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is briefly unavailable. Try again in a moment.

SignIn.title: Sign in
SignIn.description: Gize Admin, for the Gize Transport operations team.
SignIn.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, like name@gizetransport.com.
SignIn.help: No account yet, or forgot your password? Ask a Gize admin.

reasons.invalid_credentials: The email or password is wrong. Check both and try again.
reasons.not_confirmed: This account isn't confirmed yet. Open the link in your invitation email first.
reasons.rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
reasons.network: Can't reach the sign-in service. Check your connection and try again.
reasons.unavailable: The sign-in service is briefly unavailable. Try again in a moment.
reasons.unknown: Signing in didn't work. Try again; if it keeps happening, contact support.
reasons.not_staff: This account isn't on the Gize staff list, or it has been deactivated. Ask an admin for access.

Overview.title: Overview
Overview.description: The admin portal is being set up. Routes, companies, route requests, riders and drivers will appear here.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.description: This page doesn't exist, or it has moved. Check the address, or go back to the overview.

NoPermission.title: No permission
NoPermission.description: Your role can't open this. If you need it for your work, ask a Gize admin.

Areas.title: Areas
Areas.description: Neighbourhoods and landmarks. Corridors, routes and route requests choose from this list.
Areas.emptyDescription: Add the neighbourhoods and landmarks Gize serves. Corridors are made from them.
Areas.noMatchesDescription: Check the spelling, or add the area.
Areas.nameHint: As people say it, in English or Amharic. Up to 100 characters.
Areas.deleteDescription: It disappears from the list and can't be picked any more. Its name can be used again later.
Areas.inUse: A corridor, a route or an open route request uses this area, so it can't be deleted. Change those first.

AreaPicker.searchPlaceholder: Type the start of a name
AreaPicker.moreHint: Only the first matches are shown. Type more of the name to find others.
